open_points.subject: M08 AdmissionVerdict identity vs recomputation
open_points.text: "Substitution: a verdict for the same implementation and corpus is the same verdict." / "every active case of the corpus is run again for the implementation at admission time, and the verdict covers exactly those executions."
open_points.question: When the same implementation is submitted again with an unchanged corpus, does the kernel reuse the existing AdmissionVerdict or create a new one from newly run TrialExecutions?
options: Reuse existing verdict and do not create new TrialExecutions for admission
Run trials again and create a new AdmissionVerdict each submission
Run trials again but keep only one verdict per (implementation_id, corpus_digest) by replacement
open_points.default_guess: Reuse the existing verdict for the same (implementation_id, corpus_digest).

open_points.subject: M06 TrialCase.captured_from -> M23 NodeExecution reference
open_points.text: "captured_from: the NodeExecution (M23) it was captured from"
open_points.question: What exact identifier is used to reference a NodeExecution from TrialCase.captured_from?
options: Use composite key (run_id, node_id, map_index, attempt_number)
Add a minted node_execution_id to M23 and reference that
Store a full embedded snapshot of the referenced NodeExecution facts
open_points.default_guess: Use the composite key (run_id, node_id, map_index, attempt_number).

open_points.subject: M26 authority reference to FlowActivation
open_points.text: "the authority is named by its identity: ... a flow activation by its position in the store's order (M18)"
open_points.question: What concrete, stable field represents a FlowActivation's "position in the store's order" for references from EffectAttempt.authority?
options: A monotonic store sequence number exposed as activation identity
A composite reference such as (flow_version_id, activated_at)
open_points.default_guess: Use a monotonic store sequence number as the activation reference.

open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval.preview content boundary
open_points.text: "preview: what the owner saw — operation, target service, the built request and the input values; agents may read approvals"
open_points.question: Does EffectApproval.preview store full request/body/input payloads (including file bytes) or only digests/metadata for large or file inputs?
options: Store full built request and full input payloads
Store digests/metadata only for file or large payload parts
Store full payload for owner-only fields and redacted/derived fields for agent reads
open_points.default_guess: Store digests/metadata for file or large payload parts rather than full bytes.
